message.content:
**United States – Gini Coefficient (most recent estimate)**  

| Year | Gini Coefficient | Source |
|------|------------------|--------|
| 2022 | **≈ 0.416** | U.S. Census Bureau, *Income Inequality* (latest available data) |

> **Interpretation**  
> The Gini coefficient ranges from 0 (perfect equality) to 1 (perfect inequality). A value of ~0.416 indicates moderate income inequality in the U.S., comparable to many other high‑income countries.

> **Notes**  
> - The U.S. Census Bureau’s most recent published Gini coefficient is for 2022. Earlier estimates (e.g., 2021) were around 0.421.  
> - Different organizations (OECD, World Bank) may report slightly different figures due to variations in methodology and data sources. The figure above reflects the most up‑to‑date U.S. Census Bureau estimate.
